_readme.说明: 本文件是「开发者定向告示」数据源，由 notice.js 读取。JSON 标准不支持 // 注释，所以字段说明都写在 _readme 里，程序会忽略它。
_readme.文件结构: { version, updatedAt, _readme, notices: [告示对象, ...] }。真正生效的只有 notices 数组。
_readme.notices[].id: 必填，字符串，全局唯一。用于 localStorage 记录已读，改 id 会导致重复弹出。
_readme.notices[].enabled: 可选，布尔，默认 true。false 表示临时下线该告示。
_readme.notices[].author: 必填，目标开发者。支持 "4"（单个ID）、["4","5"]（多人）、"*" 或 "all"（全体开发者）。ID 对应 authors.surge.sh/authors.json 的 id。
_readme.notices[].priority: 可选，数字，默认 0。多条同时命中时按从大到小依次弹出。
_readme.notices[].startAt: 可选，ISO 时间字符串，此前不显示。留空=立即生效。
_readme.notices[].endAt: 可选，ISO 时间字符串，超过此时间自动失效。留空=永不过期。
_readme.notices[].body_zh: 必填，中文正文，支持 \n 换行。
_readme.notices[].body_en: 必填，英文正文，支持 \n 换行。
_readme.notices[].media: 可选，数组，弹窗媒体。元素写法见 media[].*。
_readme.media[].type: 必填，image 图片 / video 视频 / embed 内嵌。video 会自动识别直链和 B站、YouTube、Vimeo 链接。
_readme.media[].src: 必填，媒体地址。直链视频支持 .mp4 .webm .ogv .ogg .mov .m4v .m3u8。
_readme.media[].poster: 可选，视频封面图，仅 video 直链生效。
_readme.media[].alt: 可选，图片替代文本，仅 image 生效。
_readme.notices[].buttons: 可选，数组，底部按钮，建议最多 2 个。
_readme.buttons[].url: 必填，跳转地址，站内请写完整 URL。
_readme.buttons[].style: 可选，primary 实心主按钮 / ghost 浅色次按钮。
_readme.buttons[].target: 可选，_blank 新窗口（默认）/ _self 当前窗口。
_readme.notices[].dismissible: 可选，布尔，默认 true。false = 强制阅读，隐藏关闭按钮且点遮罩不关闭。
_readme.notices[].oncePerUser: 可选，布尔，默认 true。true = 同一用户读过一次后不再弹；false = 每次刷新都可能弹。
_readme.显示条件: 需同时满足：已登录 + 账号在 authors.json 有对应作者ID + author 匹配 + 在时间窗内 + 未读过。
_readme.生效范围: index.html、game.html、author.html、dashboard.html。游戏本体目录 /game/xxx/ 内不显示。
_readme.新增告示: 在 notices 数组末尾追加对象，复制现有示例改字段即可，注意 id 不要重复。

notices.title_zh: ⚠️ 11 月 15 日起：游戏必须具备三类法律协议
notices.title_en: ⚠️ From Nov 15: three legal agreements are required for every game
notices.body_zh:
《游戏守则》升级到 **5.0.0**，**2026 年 11 月 15 日生效**。届时缺少「用户协议 / 隐私政策 / 服务条款」任一协议的游戏将无法通过审核。投稿、推荐与「更新游戏」三类中英表单都已加入对应字段，请按以下方式填写：

• **投稿（外链 / 链接）**：在「投稿方式 = 链接」时展开的三个必填 URL 字段中，分别填入三类协议的 https 可公开访问直链。仅支持直链，不要填网盘、短链或需登录的页面。

• **投稿（代码 / 粘贴代码）**：在「补充材料」区回答「您的游戏是否已自带法律协议页面？」——选「已自带」请说明游戏内入口；选「未自带，请使用平台提供的万能协议」则无需再做任何事，平台会在详情页自动挂载通用协议。

• **推荐游戏**：在「游戏链接」下方补齐该游戏的三条协议链接；若该游戏尚未提供，请先告知其开发者补充，否则无法通过审核。

• **更新已有游戏**：在「本次更新类型」勾选「补充/更新法律协议」，并在「新的游戏链接」下方填写新的三条协议链接（选填）。代码提交的游戏无需填写，平台已自动接入万能协议。

📄 还没有协议？用「协议模板中心」免费生成：三套中英双语模板、填写即预览、支持 Markdown / TXT / HTML / PDF / Word 导出，部署到自己的游戏里再把链接提交给我们即可。

🛟 **存量游戏过渡**：11 月 15 日前已收录的游戏不会被下架，未提交专属协议的统一自动使用平台万能协议；你随时可以通过「更新游戏」补齐专属链接，经核对后生效。

📚 规则全文与 4.0.2 及更早版本的历史留存，见「游戏守则」页尾的历史版本索引。
notices.body_en:
The Game Rules are now **v5.0.0**, effective **November 15, 2026**. From that date, a game missing any of an EULA / Privacy Policy / Terms of Service cannot pass review. The Chinese and English submission, recommendation and "Update a Game" forms have all been updated — here is how to fill them in:

• **Submission (Link)**: when "Submission Method = Link" is selected, three required URL fields appear. Provide publicly accessible https direct links — no cloud drives, short links or pages behind a login.

• **Submission (Source Code / Paste code)**: answer "Does your game already include legal pages?" under supplementary materials. Choose "Yes" and state where to find them in-game, or choose "No, use the Platform's generic agreements" — in the latter case nothing else is needed, the Platform mounts the generic agreements on the detail page automatically.

• **Recommend a game**: supply the three agreement URLs below "Game Link". If the game has none yet, ask its developer to add them first, otherwise it cannot pass review.

• **Update an existing game**: tick "Update Legal Agreements" under "Update Type" and fill in the new three URLs below "New Game Link" (optional). Code-based games need not fill these in — the generic agreements are already connected.

📄 No agreements yet? Use the free Legal Template Center: three bilingual templates, live preview, and Markdown / TXT / HTML / PDF / Word export. Host them with your game, then submit the links.

🛟 **Transition for existing games**: games listed before November 15 will **not** be delisted. Those without dedicated agreements use the Platform's generic agreements automatically, and you can supply dedicated links at any time via "Update a Game"; they take effect once verified.

📚 Full rules and historical versions (4.0.2 and earlier) are linked in the version-history index at the foot of the Game Rules page.

notices.author: all
notices.title_zh: 🛠️ 现在可以在后台自助「更新游戏」了
notices.title_en: 🛠️ You can now update your game from the Dashboard
notices.body_zh:
以前更新版本、简介、玩法说明或截图都要线下沟通；现在登录开发者后台，左侧栏点「🔄 更新游戏」即可自助提交。

• 可见条件：已登录，且名下至少有 1 款游戏（没有游戏的账号看不到该入口）。
• 可提交：新版本号、本次更新内容、一句话简介、新的详细玩法说明、新增截图链接、新的游戏链接或名称变更。
• 表单按站点语言自动切换中英文；填写图片请提供 https 直链，一行一个。
• 提交后由管理员核对，通常 1–2 个工作日内同步到游戏详情页与首页列表。

同时《游戏守则》已更新至 4.0.2：链接形式提交并审核通过的游戏归为「外网游戏」；代码形式提交的游戏在作者无特别说明时默认归为「本站游戏」。如有不同需求，请在表单中特别说明。
notices.body_en:
Updating a version, summary, gameplay description or screenshots used to require manual contact. Now sign in to the developer dashboard and click "🔄 Update a Game" in the left sidebar.

• Visibility: signed in AND at least one game under your account (accounts with no games won't see it).
• You can submit: a new version number, what's new, a one-line summary, a new detailed gameplay description, new screenshot URLs, a new game URL, or name changes.
• The form switches between Chinese and English automatically with the site language. Provide https direct image links, one per line.
• Submissions are reviewed and synced to the game detail page and homepage, usually within 1–2 business days.

The Game Rules have also been updated to v4.0.2: link-based approved games are listed as "External", and code-based games are listed as "Local" by default unless the author states otherwise. If you need a different category, please say so explicitly in the form.

notices.title_zh: 3.1.0 版本更新：推荐游戏、定向告示与视频支持已上线
notices.title_en: v3.1.0 Update: Recommend a Game, Targeted Notices & Video Support Are Live
notices.body_zh:
本次 3.1.0 更新带来了多项与开发者相关的新能力：

1. 新增「推荐游戏」板块：首页可直接打开推荐表单，无需登录即可提交游戏推荐。
2. 新增开发者定向告示系统：通过 noticetodeveloper.json 配置，登录后按作者 ID 精准推送专属公告，支持图片、视频与按钮。
3. 游戏详情页支持视频：横幅与截图区域可放视频直链，或 B站、YouTube、Vimeo 链接自动转换为内嵌播放器。
4. 修复作者主页新上线游戏延迟显示的问题，上线后立即可见。
5. 全站游戏数据的 author 字段统一为字符串类型，兼容数字 ID 与人名两种写法。

欢迎前往更新日志查看完整说明。本告示有效至 2026 年 11 月 5 日 23:59。
notices.body_en:
The 3.1.0 update brings several new capabilities relevant to developers:

1. New "Recommend a Game" section: the recommendation form can be opened directly from the homepage and submitted without logging in.
2. New developer-targeted notice system: configured via noticetodeveloper.json, it pushes notices to specific authors by author ID after login, supporting images, videos and buttons.
3. Game detail pages now support video: banners and screenshots accept direct video links, or Bilibili, YouTube and Vimeo links that are automatically converted into embedded players.
4. Fixed the delayed display of newly published games on author pages; new games now appear immediately.
5. Unified the author field across all game data to string type, supporting both numeric IDs and names.

Visit the changelog for full details. This notice is valid until Nov 5, 2026, 23:59 (UTC+8).

notices.title_zh: 🎉 认证申请已通过：你已升级为「开发者」
notices.title_en: 🎉 Application approved: you are now a Developer
notices.body_zh:
Jonathan，你好！你的官方认证申请已通过人工审核。

依据《创作者认证规则》中「开发者」的要求（累计发布 ≥3 款且至少 1 款上架 ≥30 天、通过内容合规复审、保持持续更新、无严重违规），结合你名下已发布的 5 款作品（荒野生存3D v1.0.0 / v2.0.0、钢铁军团、科学大冒险、堡垒突围），你的认证等级已由「制作人 Lv.2」提升为「开发者 Lv.4 / Developer」，作者页与开发者后台的徽章会同步更新。

说明：等级徽章与红色【官方】徽章相互独立，本次升级不涉及【官方】标记。若后续希望申请「金牌开发者 Lv.5」（需累计 ≥5 款、持续稳定更新且经官方评定），可再到开发者后台提交申请。

感谢你持续为平台带来新作品，期待你的下一款游戏！
notices.body_en:
Hi Jonathan, your certification application has been approved after manual review.

Under the "Developer" criteria in the Creator Certification Rules (≥3 published games with at least one live for ≥30 days, content compliance review passed, continued updates, no serious violations), and based on your 5 published titles (Wilds Survival 3D v1.0.0 / v2.0.0, Iron Legion, Science Quest, Fortress Breakout), your level has been raised from Producer (Lv.2) to Developer (Lv.4). The badge on your author page and in the developer dashboard will update accordingly.

Note: level badges and the red [Official] badge are independent; this upgrade does not add an [Official] mark. You may apply for Gold Developer (Lv.5) later from the dashboard once you meet the criteria (≥5 titles, stable updates, official evaluation).

Thanks for continuing to build games for the platform — looking forward to your next release!
